tldr: Saturn in Leo: discipline must be learned through creativity, visibility, and humility.
body: With Saturn in Leo, the work is claiming expression without demanding constant validation. Confidence becomes real when it can survive both praise and silence.
gift: Creative discipline, dignified leadership, and reliable self-expression.
challenge: Fear of being seen, pride, or withholding gifts because recognition feels uncertain.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
